headline: Why does love never stay with me?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing showed through the backs, yet your hand found the one who still has every tool.
The cup, coin, blade and wand all remain on the table.
You asked why love never stays with you. The complete table is the part that catches me.
Love has not stayed, and “with me” has turned the question back on you.
Something sits between your capacity for love and what stays. I don't think it began with you.
Now let me look at what's holding this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You chose without seeing him and found the card held by one thing.
One rope circles one ankle. Nothing else is tied.
You asked why love does not stay. This card brings me to the single restraint.
Still, the relationships have ended, and the same question remains held.
Whatever has hold of this question keeps it returning to the same conclusion. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding the question…
c: You turned the Fool. The picture was hidden, but your hand went to the one carrying something forward.
A small bundle stays on his stick as he moves.
You asked why love leaves. What catches me is that the Fool does not leave the card empty.
But love has gone, and each ending has made you ask what remains with you.
Something appears right where love would continue rather than end. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind this…
